baseline_note: Positions come from THUD reference depth and the recorded reference camera poses (controlled experimental baseline). Results do not measure an RGB-only depth model or an estimated camera pose.
inputs_note: The fusion run and the route corridor are command-line inputs (--fusion-run, --route-config), so this file holds settings only and its hash identifies the frozen settings.
settings_provenance: v1 (Step 8, accepted): ground_plane, quality IQR limits, motion window/reset limits, labels and route settings fixed from physical reasoning before any motion evaluation; not changed after results.

v2 (declared 2026-10-13 before any Capture_2 use): motion_trust (design decision); class vote replaces reset-on-class-change; mask-coverage-change rule; evaluation.heading_min_speed_mps, distance_bins_m and ttr_lookahead_bins_s; labels.uncertainty_k with the decision rule in labels.uncertainty_k_decision.
Parameter adjustment is allowed only on Office/dynamic/Capture_2 (data_splits.json).

ground_plane.rule: predicted-floor world heights (Step 4 frames.jsonl): the median within-frame IQR must be below max_floor_height_spread_m, and at least min_fraction_frames_within_limit of the frames with floor must lie within max_floor_height_spread_m of the median height
ground_plane.rule_change: v2 (Capture_2): v1 required every frame within the limit. On Capture_2, 65 of 1237 frames put predicted 'floor' about 0.70 m above the floor (desk tops segmented as floor in close views), so the v1 rule failed although the axes were right. The robust rule tolerates such segmentation errors and lists the outlier frames.

quality.rule: reliable = position_valid AND depth IQR of the selected pixels <= the limit for its pixel_source (class_mask 0.5 m, fallback 0.25 m) AND not flagged by coverage_change. A larger IQR means at least a quarter of the pixels lie well apart from another quarter (two surfaces, e.g. an occluder in front): flagged unreliable, never resolved by picking the nearest depth cluster. No reference data is used.
quality.why: 0.5 m is about the visible depth extent of one person or chair; the fallback (box minus wall/floor/ceiling) is more exposed to other objects, so its limit is stricter.

coverage_change.rule: an observation whose selected-pixel count is more than max_ratio times larger or smaller than that of any earlier observation of the same track within window_s is flagged mask_coverage_change and does not update motion
coverage_change.why: a person walking at 1.5 m/s toward the camera from 2 m changes apparent area by about 1.4x in 0.25 s; a mask that doubles or halves that fast is a segmentation coverage change (Step 8 chair track 212), not motion. A step change flags every observation for window_s (0.25 s > max_gap_s 0.2 s), so the segment restarts after it.

motion.estimator: least-squares line fit of ground-plane x(t) and z(t) over the trailing window of reliable observations in the current segment; slope = velocity, line value at the current time = filtered position
motion.reset_rules: a new segment starts only when the gap since the previous reliable observation exceeds max_gap_s, or when the ground-plane jump exceeds jump_base_m + max_plausible_speed_mps * dt
motion.class_vote: motion_class = majority of the track's detector classes over the trailing class_vote_window_s (ties keep the previous vote). It replaces reset-on-class-change and is used for motion_trusted and per-class reporting; Step 4 pixel selection is unchanged.

labels.uncertainty_k_decision: declared before running Capture_2: adopt k = 2 if, on Capture_2, it lowers the static-verified false-motion rate AND lowers the person motion-label agreement by at most 2 percentage points; otherwise keep k = 0.
labels.rule: World speed hysteresis: moving at speed - k*se >= enter, stationary at speed + k*se <= exit, otherwise the previous state (k = uncertainty_k, se = speed standard error). A moving object is approaching / moving_away when its OWN world velocity component toward / away from camera_proxy is at least radial_min_speed_mps, otherwise moving_lateral. A new label is emitted only after it has persisted for persistence_s.

motion_trust.rule: motion_trusted = true only for an estimated motion whose motion_class is in dynamic_classes. Other classes keep their motion values with motion_trusted = false.
motion_trust.use: Step 9 decision rules use only trusted motion. Static obstacles enter decisions through the passage-width map, not through motion labels.
motion_trust.why: Design decision, not tuning. Furniture motion error is systematic drift: mask coverage changes and a viewpoint-dependent visible-surface point (46% false motion even on the reference visible point). A longer window averages noise but cannot remove drift that follows the camera's path.

route.assumption: constant ground-plane velocity from the current filtered position over the horizon; the corridor is static

evaluation.heading_rule: heading error is reported only where the REFERENCE speed >= heading_min_speed_mps; excluded pairs are counted
evaluation.distance_rule: ground-plane distance from camera_proxy to the observation's visible-surface point, from any valid-depth pixels (also for observations whose position is invalid); no valid depth -> unknown
